title: PostgreSQL SSL/TLS on Windows Server
tagline: Setting up self-signed SSL/TLS encryption to secure PostgreSQL connections.
description: I documented PostgreSQL connection encryption on Windows Server 2022. The guide covers a self-signed certificate, SSL/TLS activation and hostssl access rules.
features: Installing OpenSSL and generating a self-signed server certificate.
Enabling SSL in PostgreSQL with Windows paths handled correctly.
Updating pg_hba.conf with hostssl to enforce encryption on the targeted connections.
Checking permissions on the private key so the PostgreSQL service runs correctly.
Client connection tests with sslmode=require to validate end-to-end encryption.
challenges: I had to manage Windows paths, private-key permissions and service reloads. I then checked certificate recognition and encrypted client connections.
learnings: I strengthened my knowledge of PostgreSQL administration and SSL/TLS configuration on Windows.
